image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ mounted on a wall or balcony within a church-like setting. The instrument features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, housed in a polished reddish-brown wooden case with decorative moldings. There are multiple tiers of pipes, with the largest central pipes flanked by smaller ones. Below the main pipe array, there is a lower section with additional pipes and a decorative panel featuring what appears to be painted figures or coats of arms. To the left, a stained glass window is visible, and to the right, a hanging lantern-style light fixture.
